# Employee handbook

Welcome! This handbook covers the policies most people ask about in their first months.
If something is missing, ask in #people-ops.

## Working hours

Core hours are 10:00 to 16:00 in your local time zone. Outside core hours, organize your day
however works for you. Let your team know in standup if you will be unavailable during core hours.

## Paid time off

Everyone gets 25 days of paid vacation per calendar year, plus public holidays where you live.
Up to 5 unused days carry over to the next year; the rest expire on 31 March.
Request time off in the HR portal at least two weeks ahead for anything longer than three days.

## Sick leave

Sick days are unlimited and do not need approval. For absences longer than five working days,
send a doctor's note to people-ops so we can arrange cover.

## Parental leave

Birthing parents receive 20 weeks of fully paid leave; other parents receive 12 weeks.
Leave can start up to four weeks before the due date and can be split into two blocks.

## Remote work

The company is remote-first. You may work from any country where we have a payroll entity for
up to 90 days per year without approval. Longer stays need a tax check from finance.

## Home office equipment

New hires get a one-time budget of 1,500 EUR for a desk, chair, monitor, and accessories.
After that, 300 EUR per year is available for replacements. Keep receipts; items stay yours.

## Expenses

Submit expenses in the finance tool within 30 days, with a photo of the receipt.
Meals with clients are covered up to 60 EUR per person; add the attendees to the description.
Travel must be booked through the travel portal so it is covered by our insurance.

## Security

Use the company password manager for every work account and never reuse passwords.
Two-factor authentication is mandatory everywhere it is supported; hardware keys are provided.
Lock your screen when you step away and report lost devices to security within one hour.

## Learning budget

Each person has 1,000 EUR per year for courses, books, and conferences.
Conference attendance also includes two paid days per event, not counted as vacation.

## Leaving the company

Give notice according to your contract, return equipment you did not buy with the home office
budget, and schedule an exit interview with people-ops during your last two weeks.
